QuestInfo.name: [Hallow's Eve] Stolen Candy Hunt
QuestInfo.0: Talk to the Masked Gentleman to find out what he needs help with.
QuestInfo.2: Hunt monsters around your level to get Candy Pouches.\r\nCollect Candy Pouches to reach a score of #b1,000#k. \r\nReturn to the #bMasked Gentleman#k to start on the next step of the statue.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary:
#Wbasic#
Can proceed to Singles Army On The Move Stage 1

0.msg: Oh I'm sure you are already aware that Maple World is preparing for Halloween!\r\nEven the monsters are thinking about candy. Like that Xerxes, so full of himself...

1.msg: That is why all of MY candies have been STOLEN!\r\nThat blasted Xerxes couldn't be bothered to buy his own! You must help me if you want to come to my party! Which I know you desperately do!

2.msg: Sure, what do I need to do?

3.msg: Hunt monsters around your level to get my candy pouches back.\r\nGet #b1,000 Points#k a day for #bseven days#k to get me back on track.

4.msg: How kind! You want to make sure those candies go back to the children who really want them!

5.msg: What? Pffft, no.\r\nI will be building a statue of myself! Ha ha ha, my party will be incredible, with a great, edible ME watching over it!\r\nRemember, it's one stage each day, #b7 stages#k in all.

6.msg: Now run along and find my candies. And thanks!

7.msg: 좋다! \r\n지금이야 말로 우리 솔로부대의 위용을 보여줄 때이다. 병사여 함께 하겠는가?!

yes.0: I will hang out at the #bEvent Hall#k, so just return to me anytime before the event ends and I will take those candies.

no.0: Fine. I have many, many more people who want to be on the guest list anyway!

0.msg: I will hang out at the #bEvent Hall#k, so just return to me anytime before the event ends and I will take those candies.

1.msg: Have no mercy! Take back all the candies the monsters took from me!

2.msg: 자, 그럼 가라! 자비란 없다. 모조리 빼앗아라!!
